trigger: HER2-EXP-001 returned PMID 39243601 — T-DXd ferroptosis directly confirmed in HER2-low BC
claim: T-DXd induces ferroptosis in HER2-expressing breast cancer via two parallel resistance axes: (1) MITOCHONDRIAL AXIS — DXd payload poisons TOP1mt → VDAC3 disruption → HSPB1 ubiquitination/degradation → ferroptosis (confirmed, PMID 39243601); (2) TRANSCRIPTIONAL AXIS — HER2 internalization by trastuzumab component → PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 transcriptional suppression → ferroptosis sensitization. Tumors with high constitutive SLC7A11 (CV=59.4% in HER2-enriched TCGA) resist via Axis 2 even with normal VDAC3/HSPB1. A dual biomarker panel (SLC7A11 IHC + crVDAC3 expression) may stratify T-DXd responders with higher accuracy than either marker alone.
mechanistic_update: Prior versions relied on CPT-class analogy for ferroptosis link. PMID 39243601 (Drug Resist Updat 2024) directly confirms T-DXd induces ferroptosis in HER2-low BC via VDAC3-HSPB1 mitochondrial axis. Our novel contribution shifts to the parallel SLC7A11 transcriptional axis, which has NOT been studied in T-DXd context. The dual-axis model is the new novelty claim.

evidence.finding: T-DXd induces ferroptosis; crVDAC3-HSPB1 mitochondrial axis mediates T-DXd resistance in HER2-low BC. First direct evidence replacing class analogy.
